tests.name: short_string_copy_cbor
tests.intent: Probes short string copying optimizations during CBOR serialization of small text keys and values.

tests.name: number_runs_ubjson
tests.intent: Probes number-run optimization paths in UBJSON encoding for homogeneous numeric arrays.

tests.name: scalar_object_cbor
tests.intent: Probes scalar-only object writing optimizations in CBOR binary writer.

tests.name: out_of_range_msgpack
tests.intent: Probes out-of-line error handling and exceptions for oversized lengths in MessagePack serialization.

tests.name: vector_sink_growth_capacity
tests.intent: Probes initial capacity calculation and growth behavior in output_vector_sink for binary formats.

tests.name: binary_writer_char_adapter
tests.intent: Probes binary writer instantiation and execution over char output adapters.

tests.name: nested_binary_containers
tests.intent: Probes nested array and object binary writing across multiple formats with updated sink logic.

tests.name: empty_container_binary_writers
tests.intent: Probes serialization of empty arrays and objects across binary formats to verify zero-element handling.

tests.name: gen_21
tests.intent: Exercises output_adapter_sink with large writes and buffer flushing by writing a string larger than buffer_size into an output stream adapter.

tests.name: gen_22
tests.intent: Exercises BSON key validation and out-of-range exception handling when serializing an object key containing U+0000 (null byte).

tests.name: gen_23
tests.intent: Exercises MessagePack length validation limits and exception throwing when serializing an array with elements exceeding std::uint32_t limit.

tests.name: gen_24
tests.intent: Exercises UBJSON high-precision floating point / large number fallback encoding paths for numbers exceeding standard integer formats.

tests.name: gen_25
tests.intent: Exercises BSON fixed array sizing and fast path writing when encountering arrays of homogeneous scalar types (booleans, numbers, nulls).
